capabilities.minimum_authority: Manage general settings that do not imply customer-content access or sensitive execution.
Draft, simulate, publish, schedule, and roll back Agent Studio configuration.
Manage knowledge, culture, market, branch, location, time, and memory policy.
Manage and publish Experience Studio configuration.
Manage Commerce Control Center configured states and dependencies.
Configure Google Gemini and approved alternative provider routes, credentials references, fallbacks, budgets, and health tests.
View privacy-minimized operational summaries.
View permitted customer-visible conversation history.
View separately protected customer identity/contact data.
View authorized protected attachments.
Play authorized customer audio and view permitted transcripts.
Accept or join an authorized human handoff.
Pause or resume AI for permitted conversations.
Send customer-visible staff messages.
Add staff-only notes that can never render to customers.
Read permitted CRM cases and customer-visible history.
Assign and update permitted cases without executing commerce mutations.
Approve or reject eligible service requests according to policy.
Execute a separately authorized, revalidated, and confirmed commerce action resulting from a case.
View protected payment evidence and unverified extraction.
Request information, approve, reject, supersede, expire, or close eligible reviews.
Execute a separately authorized and confirmed WooCommerce transition after review.
View permitted analytics and evaluations.
View protected audit records.
Export permitted conversation and related personal data.
Perform eligible privacy deletion or anonymization.
Manage retention and legal-hold policy.
Grant Veyra capabilities to roles or users.
